CORRIGENDUM to Advt. No.: IPFT/PROJ-RECTT/OCT/2026 dated 05.10.2026. 
With reference to the advertisement issued by the Institute of Pesticide Formulation 
Technology (IPFT) for the Walk-in-Interview scheduled on 13 October 2026 under the project 
entitled “Augmentation of existing bio -botanical pesticides and their formulation 
facility as bio-foundry at IPFT”, the essential qualification for the post of Project Scientist-
II (Sr. No. 1) is hereby revised as follows: 
Revised Essential Qualification 
(i) Ph.D. in Chemistry/Agricultural Chemistry/Agrochemicals/Forensic/Environmental 
Science/Microbiology/Biotechnology from a recognized University/Institution or 
equivalent. 
OR 
M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering or Biotechnology with specialization in 
Microbiology/Formulation Technology from a recognized University/Institution or 
equivalent. 
(ii) Three years of experience in Research & Development in the area of biopesticides or 
pesticides or related areas. 
All other terms and conditions of the original advertisement, i ncluding desirable 
qualifications, remuneration, upper age limit, interview date and general instructions, shall 
remain unchanged. 
ESTABLISHMENT OFFICER 
For Director, IPFT

1. The above positions are purely temporary in nature and on contract basis with co-terminus on 
completion of the projects/requirements and non-transferable to any other projects. 
2. The above positions are initially for a period of one year further extendable based on continuation of 
project(s)/requirements and subject to satisfactory performance of individual. 
3. The candidates who fulfils/meets the prescribed norms for the post should attend the Walk-In-
Interview on the schedule date and time along with CV/Bio-data duly filled & signed in the prescribed 
application format along-with self-attested copies of certificates in support of their education / 
experience / age / caste etc.  
4. The candidates who fulfil the prescribed norms of the posts notified and are desires to apply for more 
than one post shall require to submit separately their CV/Bio-data in prescribed application format 
along with all self-attested testimonials. 
5. Cut-off date for determining the upper age limit, qualification, experience etc. shall be the date of 
interview. The age relaxation as per GoI norms is available to eligible applicants. However, in the case 
of deserving candidates, who are found suitable, the age/experience relaxation can be considered by 
the Selection Committee subject to the approval of the Competent Authority.  
6. The Institute reserves the right to fill or reject/modify all or any specific posts as notified in the 
advertisement.  
7. The numbers of vacancies are indicative and may be increased or decreased. The number of posts 
advertised are provisional and can be varied as per the requirement of the Institute. 
8. It may be noted that offer of contractual hiring/appointment against the advertised post/s will not 
confer any right on the selected candidates for absorption in IPFT or claiming any status whatever.  
9. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. 
10. The well deserving candidates with relevant qualification and performances will be encouraged for 
Ph.D. Enrolment. 
11. No TA/DA shall be payable for attending the interview.
